description: This source file contains unit tests for the Orleans placement filter mechanisms, specifically testing silo metadata placement filters. It defines a test class with multiple test methods that verify different placement filtering scenarios, as well as several grain class implementations with placement filter attributes that are used during testing.

classes.name: SiloMetadataPlacementFilterTests
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of various silo metadata placement filters within Orleans. Contains test methods for scenarios involving filter correctness, fallback behavior, and metadata matching conditions.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_GrainWithoutFilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Tests that a grain can be called without applying any placement filter.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_RequiredFilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Verifies that the required filter can be called and returns expected hosting silo.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_PreferredFilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Checks that the preferred filter correctly assigns grains to silos matching their metadata.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_PreferredMin2FilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Ensures grains are placed on silos respecting the minimum placement count requirement.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_PreferredMultipleFilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Tests placement on silos based on multiple preferred metadata conditions.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_PreferredMin2FilterCanBeCalledWithLargerCluster
methods.description: Validates placement logic when the cluster size is larger, respecting minimum constraints.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_PreferredNoMetadataFilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Verifies fallback behavior when no specific metadata is provided for placement filtering.

classes.name: IUniqueRequiredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that indicates it requires matching silo metadata with 'unique' key for placement.

methods.name: GetHostingSilo
methods.description: Returns the address of the silo hosting this grain.

classes.name: UniqueRequiredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a grain that uses a placement filter requiring 'unique' silo metadata key. Defines silo hosting retrieval.

classes.name: IPreferredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: Interface for grains that specify preferred placement based on silo metadata 'unique'.

classes.name: PreferredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a grain with a placement filter that prefers silos with 'unique' metadata.

classes.name: IPreferredMatchMin2FilteredGrain
classes.description: Interface for grains requiring placement on silos respecting a minimum count in metadata.

classes.name: PreferredMatchMinTwoFilteredGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a grain that prefers silos with 'unique' metadata, respecting minimum placement constraints.

classes.name: IPreferredMatchMultipleFilteredGrain
classes.description: Interface for grains with placement expecting multiple metadata keys.

classes.name: PreferredMatchMultipleFilteredGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a grain with placement filter for multiple metadata keys.

classes.name: IPreferredMatchNoMetadataFilteredGrain
classes.description: Interface for grains that match silos ignoring metadata keys.

classes.name: PreferredMatchNoMetadataFilteredGrain
classes.description: Implementation for grains with default placement regardless of metadata keys.
